Enabled.Name: Report gig outcomes to Night City Investments
Enabled.Hint: When a gig is marked completed or failed in Night City Map, tell Night City Investments so the client's share price can react. Turn off to stop reporting without disabling the module.

Warn.NoInvestments: Night City Investments is not active, so gig outcomes cannot be reported.
Warn.OldInvestments: This version of Night City Investments cannot receive gig outcomes. Update it to version 0.6.0 or later.
Warn.NoMap: Night City Map is not active, so there are no gigs to watch.
